target: Era preciso que todos colaborassem.
english: It was necessary for everyone to collaborate.
tip: era preciso que (it was necessary that) forces the subjunctive: que todos colaborassem, not colaboraram.

target: Eles têm viajado bastante este ano.
english: They've been traveling a lot this year.
tip: têm with the circumflex is the plural have (eles têm); the singular tem has no accent.

target: Eu tenho ido ao dentista regularmente.
english: I've been going to the dentist regularly.
tip: The preposition a and the article o contract into ao: tenho ido ao dentista, never a o dentista.

target: Nós tínhamos ouvido boatos sobre a empresa.
english: We had heard rumors about the company.
tip: Portuguese builds the compound past with ter, not haver: tínhamos ouvido is 'we had heard'.

target: Ele agiu como se nada tivesse acontecido.
english: He acted as if nothing had happened.
tip: como se (as if) takes the past subjunctive: como se nada tivesse acontecido, not tinha acontecido.

target: Ela tinha se mudado recentemente para o bairro.
english: She had recently moved to the neighborhood.
tip: mudar-se with the pronoun means to move house, not just to change: tinha se mudado para o bairro.

target: Eu desejava que meus filhos tivessem mais oportunidades.
english: I wished my children had more opportunities.
tip: desejar que triggers the subjunctive for a wish: desejava que meus filhos tivessem mais oportunidades.

target: A fim de que todos entendam, vou falar devagar.
english: So everyone understands, I'll speak slowly.
tip: a fim de que (so that) states purpose and takes the subjunctive: a fim de que todos entendam.

target: Ela tem feito academia todo dia.
english: She's been going to the gym every day.
tip: fazer academia is the everyday phrase for working out at the gym: tem feito academia todo dia.

target: Mesmo que ele quisesse, não poderia vir.
english: Even if he wanted to, he couldn't come.
tip: mesmo que (even if) always takes the subjunctive: mesmo que ele quisesse, not mesmo que queria.

target: Se a empresa pagasse melhor, ninguém sairia.
english: If the company paid better, nobody would leave.
tip: Unreal conditions pair se plus the imperfect subjunctive with a conditional result: se pagasse, sairia.

target: Ele tinha escrito o relatório antes do prazo.
english: He had written the report before the deadline.
tip: escrever has the irregular participle escrito, not escrevido: tinha escrito o relatório.

target: Eu tinha dito que não ia dar certo.
english: I had said it wasn't going to work.
tip: dar certo is a fixed phrase meaning to work out or turn out well: não ia dar certo.

target: Ele tinha ganhado o prêmio no ano anterior.
english: He had won the prize the year before.
tip: ganhar has two participles; with ter the regular ganhado is used: tinha ganhado o prêmio.

target: Eu tinha posto a mesa quando ela chegou.
english: I had set the table when she arrived.
tip: pôr has the irregular participle posto: tinha posto a mesa = had set the table.

target: Antes de mais nada, quero agradecer a todos.
english: First of all, I want to thank everyone.
tip: agradecer takes a before the person thanked: agradecer a todos, not agradecer todos.

target: Eu tinha acabado de chegar quando a festa começou.
english: I had just arrived when the party started.
tip: 'Tinha acabado de' + infinitive = 'had just' done something.

target: Quem dera a gente morasse perto um do outro.
english: I wish we lived close to each other.
tip: quem dera expresses a wish and is followed by the imperfect subjunctive: quem dera a gente morasse perto.

target: Se houvesse mais vagas, todos seriam contratados.
english: If there were more positions, everyone would be hired.
tip: haver meaning there is or there are becomes houvesse in the past subjunctive: se houvesse mais vagas.

target: Se eu soubesse que você estava aqui, teria vindo antes.
english: If I had known you were here, I would have come earlier.
tip: se soubesse covers both 'if I knew' and 'if I had known'; the same form serves present and past hypotheticals.

target: Os documentos foram entregues ontem.
english: The documents were delivered yesterday.
tip: 'Entregues' agrees in gender and number with the subject 'documentos'.

target: Eu te mandei uma mensagem, viu?
english: I sent you a message, okay?
tip: Viu at the end works like right? or okay?, a spoken tag checking the listener got it, not the verb ver.

target: Se nós pudéssemos, ficaríamos mais tempo.
english: If we could, we'd stay longer.
tip: Hypotheticals pair Se plus the -sse subjunctive (pudéssemos) with the -ria conditional (ficaríamos) in the result.

target: É recomendável beber bastante água.
english: It's recommended to drink plenty of water.
tip: After the impersonal É recomendável, use a plain infinitive (beber), not a conjugated or subjunctive verb.

target: Era como se o tempo tivesse parado.
english: It was as if time had stopped.
tip: Como se, meaning as if, always takes the subjunctive; tivesse parado is the past form for something that had happened.

target: Eles pediram que eu trouxesse o documento.
english: They asked me to bring the document.
tip: Verbs of requesting like pedir que push the following verb into the subjunctive: trouxesse, not trouxe.

target: Ele costuma almoçar no mesmo restaurante.
english: He usually has lunch at the same restaurant.
tip: Costuma plus an infinitive (almoçar) means usually does something; it stands in for an English usually adverb.

target: Se eu fosse você, aceitaria a proposta.
english: If I were you, I'd accept the proposal.
tip: Se eu fosse você is the set phrase for giving advice, if I were you; fosse is the subjunctive of ser.

target: Gostaria que houvesse mais opções de transporte.
english: I'd like there to be more transportation options.
tip: Houvesse is the there were form of haver; like há, it stays singular no matter how many things follow (opções).

target: A exposição será aberta ao público amanhã.
english: The exhibition will be open to the public tomorrow.
tip: Future passive: 'será/serão + participle' – the participle still agrees with the subject in gender and number.
